verdict.rationale: Snyk documents a dedicated Snyk Container product that finds and fixes vulnerabilities in container images, including in registries and in network-restricted private registries via the Broker Container Registry Agent. The docs frame this as building security in from the start, which supports scanning before deployment. The evidence never separates OS-package from application-layer findings, and it shows no container-specific CLI or CI gating workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OS-package vs application-dependency layer detection, a documented container CLI/CI pre-deploy scan command, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can scan container images for OS-package and application-layer vulnerabilities before deploying them

citations.quote: Snyk Container provides tools and integrations to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities. This allows you to create images that have security built-in from the start.
Scan, prioritize, and fix vulnerabilities in your code, open-source dependencies, container images, and cloud configurations.
Snyk can integrate with self-hosted private container registries that are not internet-accessible and can help you to better secure container images in those registries.
The Snyk Broker Container Registry Agent enables you to connect with network-restricted container registries so you can scan these registries using the Snyk service.
